title: crypto2dev_compat.h: kernel 5.10–6.x compatibility shims
description: The kernel crypto API changed in several places between 5.10 and 6.x. This header provides version-gated shims so the registration code does not litter #ifdefs. Must handle at minimum: crypto_skcipher_alg struct layout changes, CRYPTO_ALG_* flag differences, scatterwalk API changes between versions, and any mutex/refcount API changes. Shims go in wolfkm_compat.h (included by all src/ files via wolfkm_reg.h).
notes: Target kernels: 5.10 (RHEL 8 backport), 5.15 (Ubuntu 22.04, Debian 12), 6.1 (Debian 13), 6.6 (Ubuntu 24.04 HWE), 6.8 (Ubuntu 24.04). RHEL 9 (5.14) is also a target.
design: Use #include <linux/version.h> and LINUX_VERSION_CODE / KERNEL_VERSION() macros. Pattern: #if LINUX_VERSION_CODE < KERNEL_VERSION(x,y,z) ... #else ... #endif. Consult /proc/version on target kernels. Document each shim with the kernel version it covers and why.
